diagnosis: AccountFlashNotificationQueueView returns queued flash notifications for an account. The view takes account_id directly from request.GET without verifying that request.user has membership in or ownership of that account. An attacker can supply arbitrary account IDs to view pending flash alerts, multi-factor backup reminder codes, and billing notices queued for other corporate accounts.
exploit_request:
GET /api/notifications/queue/?account_id=502 HTTP/1.1
Host: b2b.apphub.com
Cookie: sessionid=tenant_user_session
Accept: application/json
